summary:
HELIOS is a platform that unifies and harmonizes wildfire detection data from the MODIS and VIIRS satellite instruments.
It groups detections based on spatial and temporal proximity to identify common fire hotspots and reduce duplicates.
It also applies an empirical scaling factor to normalize Fire Radiative Power (FRP) measurements between both instruments.
Historical wildfire records from EFFIS are used to support this process.
The result is a more consistent and comparable dataset, regardless of the observing sensor.
HELIOS aims to improve wildfire monitoring, environmental research and predictive modelling, contributing to SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 15 (Life on Land).
